newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria offers 16,000 tonnes of lentils for sale.
newsitem.headline: Syria offers 16,000 tonnes of lentils for sale.

text.p: Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade (GECPT) has offered 16,000 tonnes of lentils for export, an official spokesman said on Monday.
He told Reuters an international call for prices setting May 20 as the final date to receive bids had been issued. Confirmation would be made on May 21.
The spokesman said lentils from the 1996 crop would be ready for shipment immediately and until July 15.
Partial offers would be acceptable up to 1,000 tonnes, he said.
